findings.statement: 31 reservations/results match individual files; 30 distinct requested URLs, Fremont 20 and Pueblo 11. Cumulative retained body bytes 14,821,045; largest body 10,756,377. All visible procedural counts are within 40 actions/20 per county/30 URLs/20MB source/80MB total. Browser hidden traffic and transport byte-enforcement are not measured.

Current ARTIFACT_INVENTORY has 166 valid member hashes. Frozen delivery contains 170 files: inventory excludes itself and three later R1 files. All 170 are preserved and separately hash-bound here; R1 conclusions are not accepted by this audit.

The original 166-entry hash-summary is stale for ACTION_LOG, ARTIFACT_INVENTORY, the report and A027 result. Current report matches observed UI SHA eba5c06b0e2f0872c7c412101007f1aebbe270cbf31af24d405a8292d8ec2d80. Report explains correction of HTTP 000 to null/transport error; no old bytes for those four prior versions are retained here, only their old digest claims. See analysis-calculations for exact old/current hashes.

Four PDF bodies, 749 structural pages, are retained: 190+4+553+2. A016 is the two-page accountability presentation omitted from report highlights, not a new legal instrument. Direct visual scope is four first pages only.

Twelve priority IDs represent eleven distinct resource URLs: priorities 10 and 11 repeat the same planning page with browser-derivative success and curl-403 error. Preserve both events but one resource. Priority 12 is also a blocked/error-body lead; error HTML is not collected legal/catalog text. Priority 10 original_body field references rendered DOM, not HTTP original bytes.

All 24 checklist authority/category pairs are unique. Fremont: 10 candidate_found, 2 not_searched. Pueblo: 4 candidate_found, 3 access_blocked, 5 not_searched. Thirteen backlog URLs are distinct and absent from requested URLs. These lead/checklist statuses do not establish legal completeness; backlog is a selected subset of all discovered links.

Fremont fee HTML explicitly reports adoption at the 10/15/2024 Board meeting and EFFECTIVE DECEMBER 1, 2024. It also mentions uses in a 2025 zoning resolution. Preserve these separate page assertions; cover 2024 claims do not reconcile the zoning edition. No full fee-table QA performed.

A012 repeated ordinary curl access to the exact seed already known to return 403; the supplied exception authorized one ordinary browser alternate, not another curl retry. A027 .us homepage and A029/A030 planning paths have no exact match in preserved seed/comparison JSON or earlier retained HTML links. A028 .gov homepage is present in legacy input. No retained search-result proof supports A027/A029/A030. These routes must not be certified as observed-link-only compliance. No evidence here establishes a bypass mechanism.

A031 rendered DOM contains the exact fee-PDF anchor and label copied in DIRECTED_PROPOSAL. Its final URL/status/redirect observations are tool-reported; no original HTTP headers/body are retained for this browser action. Fee PDF was not opened. Link label 5.8.25 is not a verified adoption date.

Recorded reservation/completion times are sequential and precede the research stop. Times are received log assertions, not independently authenticated wall-clock evidence or proof of pre-action reservation persistence. All visible final URLs equal requests; no exposed redirect is logged. Curl result headers contain no cookie/auth fields; absence is a retained-public-header observation, not proof none existed on the wire.

Fremont exact PDF links A001/A002 appear in later preserved official A003 HTML; other A013-A026 navigation targets have earlier preserved links. Pueblo A007 is an exact historical registry seed with county-labeled cover, but no fresh official parent anchor appears in retained HTML. No City of Pueblo source is treated as county evidence. Historical URL/digest reconciliation is delegated to separately delivered R1, not silently accepted here.
